theme.description: A mix of Swiss authority with modern fintech depth. It needs to convey ultimate trust, legal validity, and cutting-edge AI processing for condominium audits in Peru.

rules: MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large sizes.
Avoid generic bold. Use Black/900 for impact or Light/300 for elegance.
Loose leading for readable legal/audit text (leading-relaxed).
High contrast for audit data. Warnings/Irregularities in Signal Red (#DC2626).
Do not use Teal Green/Blue for dashboards.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have padding to avoid collision.
layouts.grid_strategy_marketing: Tetris Grid: Asymmetry, gap-8 to gap-12, col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero.
layouts.grid_strategy_dashboard: High Density Grid: Data Correlation. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Stretch children vertically.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first responsive. Optical alignment over geometrical alignment.

surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.marketing_hero: Hero image max overlay opacity: bg-black/50. If image isn't visible, it's too dark. Use textures like noise/grain.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism for sticky navs: backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, 1px delicate inner stroke, soft ambient shadow. NEVER use fully transparent background.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layout or subtle 1px border. Cardless dense tables preferred.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion for micro-interactions. Ensure accessible motion rules.

components_strategy.marketing: Pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts. No Shadcn Card wrappers to avoid rigidity. Raw divs for overlapping.
components_strategy.dashboard: Shadcn UI (tables, dropdowns, dialogs). Customize Shadcn default spacing and radii. Recharts for Gemini data visualization.
components_strategy.forms: ALWAYS use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, customized to not look like default Vercel.
components_strategy.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for high-end UI.

hero_architecture.description: white modern cement building under blue sky - use as background for landing page hero section

lima_cityscape.description: road near body of water and buildings at daytime - use for 'Nosotros' or context section

financial_audit.description: graphs of performance analytics - use for Gemini AI Analysis feature representation

professional_audit.description: person holding pencil near laptop computer - use for 'Auditoria' / features section

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs or simplistic gradients.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.
